endorsements.quote: To report the metrics and visualization used to assess model performance, researchers constructing or validating clinical prediction models should explicitly state all performance metrics and visualizations used, and the rationale for their selection.

unlisted_practices: Report calibration performance and clinical utility measures, such as decision-curve analysis and net benefit, when model outputs are intended to support risk estimation or diagnostic decision-making.
Use bootstrap resampling to construct confidence intervals for classification metrics such as precision, recall, and F-score rather than relying on Wald formulas, especially with small samples.
Supplement weighted-average metrics with per-class or macro-averaged scores to avoid masking poor minority-class performance.
Define acceptable operating performance in relation to the intended clinical role, expected prevalence in the target population, and the consequences of diagnostic error.

screen.reason: The paper introduces TRIAGE, a framework and checklist providing guidance and recommendations on how to evaluate, report, and safeguard diagnostic AI models for safe clinical adoption.
